Alan Sexton, home on leave from the R.A.F., turned out in the 300 yards and although not fit, managed to finish in third place to Pugh, of S.L.H., and Pike, of the Poly, both International runners.
Reg Bolam was third in the mile, with Bob Taylor fourth and Basil Walden was second to Pugh, of S.L.H., in the 220, with Des Mullen in third place.
